title: dbt Cloud Job Run Failures
dataSources: dbt Cloud Admin API runs (`dbtcloud:run`), Discovery API, and dbt artifacts (`dbt:run_results`, `dbt:manifest`).
app: dbt Cloud Admin API (`/api/v2/accounts/{id}/runs`) and Metadata (Discovery) API via HEC scripted inputs; dbt run artifacts (`run_results.json`, `manifest.json`) forwarded as `dbt:run_results`.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dbtcloud:run
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status="error" OR is_error="true")) as failures by job_name
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Counts dbt Cloud job runs and ranks jobs by failure rate using the Admin API run status, covering the managed-dbt path distinct from dbt Core CLI runs.
value: dbt Cloud jobs power scheduled transformations; ranking failures by job pinpoints the transformations breaking downstream marts.
implementation: Poll the dbt Cloud Admin API runs endpoint into HEC; schedule hourly and alert on failures for production jobs.
visualization: Table of job by failure rate, timechart of failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch your managed dbt jobs and flag the ones that keep failing so the tables they build stay correct.
